name: BPAF Marine Conservation Program Grants
summary: Grants of up to USD 50,000 from the Bahamas Protected Areas Fund, financed through the Bahamas marine debt conversion, for community marine protected areas, mangrove work, coastal resilience and blue economy projects. Concepts are invited in calls, then shortlisted for full proposals.
reporting: Periodic progress reports (narrative and financial) and final narrative and financial reports, with lessons learned and a financial audit or report for the whole project.

deadline.quote: complete the concept application through the BPAF online portal no later than 11:59 pm EST on September 30th, 2026.

applicant_types.quote: Legally registered NGOs or CBOs with the Registrar General Office and must have been registered for at least one year prior to September 2026. Local academic institutions and research organizations Government Agencies and departments

geography.quote: to ensure sustainable financing into perpetuity for the management of the Bahamas National Protected Areas System

access.quote: Interested organizations should complete the concept application through the BPAF online portal no later than 11:59 pm EST on September 30th, 2026.

window.quote: Applicants have 30 days from the start of the call for proposals to submit their concept applications

amount.quote: The maximum funding available for successful projects will be $50,000.00(USD).

reporting.quote: All grant awardees are required to provide periodic progress reports and a final report at the end of the project.
